note: Two distinct names in the record. (1) AREZO AVIATION SERVICES: 121 customs records on ImportKey, but every visible row is an IMPORT into India (Delhi Air Cargo / Sahar Air) of aircraft parts from UAE, US, UK suppliers (AVITRUE SPARES DMCC, OSTECH L.L.C-FZ, MIRUS AIRCRAFT SEATING, ALPHA AIRCRAFT SYSTEMS, YORACRAFT, MK1 GMBH); its own buyer list shows Russian counterparties (AIRCOMPANY NORTH-WEST LLC, PDS AVIA LLC, FLIGHT TIME JSC) but no outbound B/L rows were visible for it. (2) PRATNA INTERNATIONAL LLP: 5 confirmed outbound shipments Jun-Aug 2025, all HS 88073010 aircraft parts, from Calicut ACC to Sheremetyevo (Russia) and Dubai. The link between the two names is NOT established by any public record I saw — the claimed PAN ABCFA3712C and the Delhi state claim could not be verified against either name (PAN/CIN not public in the sources read). HS mismatch is material: declared 810890/841350/848110/880211 (metals, pumps, valves, turbine parts) versus actual 88073010 (aircraft parts) on all 5 export rows and 90148090/84119900/85365090/94019900 on the import rows — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; actual HS is 88073010 for exports. Industry claim "Металлургия и горнодобыча" is not supported: the trade is aviation spares. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null (not public). Sanctions-adjacent note: exports go to Russian buyers (REGAR LLC, Moscow) — neutral, not a rejection ground. Verdict basis: real outbound shipments exist for the claimed legal entity, so export_status = confirmed; no domestic supply trail found for either name.
